summary.zh: 评估客户账户健康度、流失风险与增购机会
summary.en: Scores account health, churn risk and expansion chances

description.zh: 逐个检查客户账户的健康状况，给出流失风险评分，并找出可以追加销售或扩展使用的机会。适合客户成功团队做定期账户复盘、续约前评估，或为跟进工作排优先级。
description.en: Reviews customer accounts one by one: scores account health, estimates churn risk and surfaces expansion or upsell opportunities. Useful for recurring account reviews, pre-renewal checks and setting follow-up priorities.
